additional_info.body:
Hello Cenoiu, good morning.
I checked the logs and it seems that it's limited due to ELMS. I send in attachment the logs that show how the External Load Management is limiting the charging sessions.
I can also see from my side that in the beginning, when we plug in, the charger is showing the capability of providing 400kW:
These 2 logs are for each outlet, right before the session starts.
Since the problem is related to the ELMS logic, I advise you to reach out to the personnel responsible for this. I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
